setup: Open a folder, start a local web server, and turn the setting on.
open: Paste a file link into Quick Open: it offers to open it. Press Enter: the file opens here, on line three.
side: From the README, paste the same link and press Option Enter: it opens beside it, and the README stays.
handlers: For a localhost link, with the shared setting on, the side button opens it in the integrated browser, next to the README.
